name: tokenless
description: Standalone managed Playwright bridge for visible AI provider sessions.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:scripts && npm run build:link
scripts.docs:capture-readme-dashboard: npm run build --workspace packages/cli && node scripts/capture-readme-dashboard.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run api:check && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e:web-provider: npm run build && node test/run-live-provider-e2e.mjs web-ui
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/run-live-provider-e2e.mjs run --gate all
scripts.test:e2e:non-submission: npm run build && node test/run-live-provider-e2e.mjs run --gate non_submission
scripts.test:e2e:mutation: npm run build && node test/run-live-provider-e2e.mjs run --gate mutation
scripts.test:e2e:project: npm run build && node test/run-live-provider-e2e.mjs run --gate project
scripts.test:e2e:fallback: npm run build && node test/run-gated-e2e.mjs provider-fallback
